Question 6
?

If f(x)=x2sin⁡(5x+2), find f′(x).

a
2x2sin⁡(5x+2)+5xcos⁡(5x+2)
b
2sin⁡(5x+2)+5x2cos⁡(5x+2)
c
5xsin⁡(5x+2)+2x2cos⁡(5x+2)
d
2xsin⁡(5x+2)+x2cos⁡(5x+2)
e
2xsin⁡(5x+2)+5x2cos⁡(5x+2)
